info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Customer Debit Card-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the creation of debit cards for customers within the banking microservice ecosystem. By leveraging this endpoint, financial institutions can provision new debit cards to enhance customer banking experiences. The operation is critical for customer onboarding and financial product offerings. Typical consumers include banking application developers and customer service teams looking to automate card issuance processes. This API ensures that customer and transaction data are securely managed during the card creation workflow.

post.summary: Create a new debit card for a customer.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new debit card for a specific customer identified by their unique customer ID. Ensure you provide all the necessary details for the debit card in the request body. Upon successful creation, the system will return the details of the newly created debit card.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create a new debit card associated with the customer identified by CUST-100045. It requires specific parameters to be sent in JSON format, ensuring that all essential details for the debit card creation are provided.
